'''Elfraed Guitama''' was a leader during the reign of [[Artur Hawkwing]].

== History ==
After Hawkwing's death, Guitama was advised by [[Jalwin Moerad]]. He was one of three people to come closest to seizing the late Hawkwing's [[Artur Hawkwing's Empire|empire]].{{ref/book|bwb|12}}
